GUTTATUM (Rose) Rose, 1904 (engl./ fr.)Synonym : Sedum guttatum Rose (1903)
异名：Distribution : Mexico (Coahuila, Nuevo León), 1200 – 2100 m.
地理分布墨西哥（Coahuila, Nuevo León）海拔1200-2100米Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述：（根据2003年IHSP）Plants 5 – 20 cm tall.
植株5-20厘米高。Leaves rhombic-ovate to –obovate or –lanceolate, low-rounded at the very tip, 2 – 4 x 2 cm, grey-green blotched with purplish-red.
叶片菱形-卵形到倒卵形或披针形，较前端圆形，2–4×2厘米，有灰绿色和紫红色斑点。Inflorescences cymes with few cincinni of 8 – 15 flowers.
花序聚伞花序和少数蝎尾聚伞花序，8-15朵花。Flowers : Sepals rounded at tips, corolla yellow, outside with red lines.
花：萼片圆尖，花冠黄色，外面有红线。Cytology : n = 32, 33
染色体：n=32,33

Photo Corrado Coccorese

TEXANUM (J.G.Smith) J.N.Rose, 1904 (engl./ fr.)Synonyms :
异名Sedum texanum J.G.Smith (1895) / Villadia texana (J.G.Smith) Rose (1903)
Lenophyllum pusillum Rose (1905)Distribution : USA (S Texas), NE Mexico; below 100 m.
地理分布：美国（德克萨斯州南部），墨西哥东北部；海拔100米以下Description (according to IHSP, 2003) :
描述：（根据2003年IHSP）Plants 10 – 40 cm tall, green becoming reddish.
植株10-40厘米高，颜色由绿变红。Leaves ovate-lanceolate to elliptic to oblanceolate, acuminate, 1 – 2.5 x 0.4 – 1 cm.
叶卵状-披针形到椭圆形到倒披针形，渐尖，1-2.5 x 0.4-1厘米。Inflorescences racemes or spikes or narrow thyrses, 2 – 15 x 1.2 – 2 cm, with 5 – 25 commonly 1-flowered branches.
花序为总状花序或穗状花序或狭窄的聚伞圆锥花序，2-15 x 1.2-2厘米，每支花枝通常开5-25朵。Flowers : Sepals acute to acuminate, corolla buffy or dull yellow, often marked with red.
花：萼片锐尖到渐尖，花冠淡黄色或暗黄色，往往带有明显的红色。Cytology : n = 44
染色体：n=44Note :
注意：In the greenhouse this plant can become very invasive, and nurseries consider it a pest. Leaves and bracts detach and root easily and produce multitudes of new plantlets.
这种植物在温室和苗圃入侵性会变得极强，认为它是一种有害植物。叶片和苞片脱落后，容易生根并产生大量新植株。

Photos Corrado Coccorese
